contract: Whenever Cal.com decides whether to show its own name/logo on anything an attendee sees for a given event, that decision must come from one resolver that considers the whole ownership chain — team → parent organization for team events, and user → organization profile for a personal event (packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts:35-181) — so that every outbound surface for the same event agrees. Any call site that instead reads a single denormalized field (typically eventType.owner.hideBranding, or team.hideBranding OR user.hideBranding without the org parent), or that omits the flag entirely, breaks the contract: it silently returns false for team-owned events (whose eventType has no owner) and for org-inherited settings, re-branding confirmation/reminder emails and SMS, the pre-booking verification code message, and the post-payment notifications that the paid white-label plan is supposed to strip.

defect_location.summary: The correct contract is packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts:35-181 (resolveHideBranding at :35-45 lets an organization setting override the entity, shouldHideBrandingForEvent at :116-153 branches team-vs-user, wrappers at :158-181). The booking page and payment page honour it — apps/web/modules/bookings/views/bookings-single-view.getServerSideProps.tsx:13,251-255 and packages/features/ee/payments/pages/payment.tsx:6,58-60 — which is why the page people book on is right. The notification paths do not. packages/features/bookings/lib/service/RegularBookingService.ts:2620,2804,2819 passes hideBranding: !!eventType.owner?.hideBranding || !!platformClientId into workflow/reminder scheduling; the same owner-only expression appears at packages/features/bookings/lib/handleConfirmation.ts:458,471, packages/features/bookings/lib/handleBookingRequested.ts:103, packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts:464, packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/confirm.handler.ts:567, packages/features/handleMarkNoShow.ts:404, packages/features/ee/round-robin/roundRobinManualReassignment.ts:669 (and a hard-coded hideBranding: true at :602), and packages/features/ee/managed-event-types/reassignment/services/ManagedEventManualReassignmentService.ts:186. For a team event eventType.owner is null, so the expression is false and the mark reappears — exactly the team-vs-personal divergence reported. The paid-booking path repeats it at packages/app-store/_utils/payments/handlePaymentSuccess.ts:231 (BOOKING_PAID trigger), fed by the owner-only Prisma selection in packages/features/bookings/lib/payment/getBooking.ts:38-42. A second, independent resolver exists at packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:519-535 — return !!booking.eventType.team.hideBranding for team bookings else !!booking.user?.hideBranding — which never consults the parent organization, and it feeds every reminder render at :246,272,300,433 via isBrandingDisabled. That flag then flows through packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/reminderScheduler.ts:53,93,159,213,248,262,267,280, packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/emailReminderManager.ts:38,117,151,189,211, packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/scheduleMandatoryReminder.ts:18,27,38,82 and packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/EmailWorkflowService.ts:97,241,453,468,554 — the last of which already does it correctly via getHideBranding (EmailWorkflowService.ts:8,251-269), as does packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/WorkflowService.ts:11,133-145, which is the in-repo proof that the shared resolver is the intended source. The pre-booking verification code carries no branding flag at all: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/auth/sendVerifyEmailCode.handler.ts:33-38 forwards only email/username/language/isVerifyingEmail to packages/features/auth/lib/verifyEmail.ts:88-93, with the input contract at packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/auth/sendVerifyEmailCode.schema.ts and the caller at apps/web/modules/bookings/hooks/useVerifyEmail.ts:31,55-59 — so the vendor mark is unconditional there. The supporting data reads that must widen are packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking/getEventTypesFromDB.ts:111, packages/features/bookings/lib/getBookingToDelete.ts:57, packages/features/bookings/repositories/BookingRepository.ts:462, packages/features/bookings/lib/handleConfirmation.ts:310,360 and packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/getWorkflowReminders.ts:170,201 (team selected without parent), against the org-aware queries already available at packages/features/ee/teams/repositories/TeamRepository.ts:436-443 and packages/features/users/repositories/UserRepository.ts:1323-1332.
